files.note: female hero covered in teal blob slimes

how_made: Imagine text-to-image of a right-facing female fantasy hero with teal blob slimes on head, shoulders, torso and boot. Hot-pink key removed, cropped, nearest-neighbour to 64x64, 23-color palette, binary alpha. Encoded as palette + 64 character rows because the GitHub connector cannot carry raw PNG bytes reliably.
self_check: hero-slime.txt: 1 palette line (23 hex colors) + 64 rows of length 64. '.' is transparent. decode.py rebuilds a 64x64 RGBA PNG matching the generated sprite.
